patches_added.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches_added.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off.

patches_added.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches_added.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches_added.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches_added.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.2.2. Adds a UI density setting, a problem report and a safe mode.

patches_added.name: Send to car
patches_added.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to Maps Car through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links).

patches_removed.name: BYD native battery experiment
patches_removed.description: Experimental: sends this BYD's battery and road-load model to Google through Maps' native EV route requests. Starts from the car's own average consumption, learns slowly from BMS energy/distance, and adds in-app vehicle settings. Native hooks inspected on Maps 26.41 and 26.42. Targets BYD DiLink 3; DiLink 5 unverified.

patches_removed.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches_removed.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.2, skips the uncertified-device screen, avoids a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open, and prefers synthesized navigation speech with early Google TTS startup and the existing audio fallback.

patches_added.description: Includes tracking controls. Saves OneTrust's real Reject All choice after SDK readiness and skips automatic notification setup. Notifications default off; manual privacy and notification settings remain available.

patches_added.name: Ambient light
patches_added.description: Puts a soft glow in a post's own colors around its photo or video in Home and Following, and in the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. The glow follows a video as it plays, and you pick how far it spreads and how fast it changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: App-only proxy
patches_added.description: Sends Instagram through an HTTP proxy you set, without changing the proxy for other apps or the phone. You need to set a server too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_added.name: Carousel arrows
patches_added.description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Explore without personalization
patches_added.description: Where Instagram lets you turn off personalization in Explore (in the EU), opens Explore on the grid that isn't personalized every time and keeps it from switching back after ten minutes. A second switch hides the menu button for it. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_added.name: Mark one-time photos and videos
patches_added.description: Puts a border and Instagram's own view once icon on a one-time photo or video in a chat, so you can tell it before you open it. Only how the chat looks changes. Nothing is saved, replayed, marked seen or sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_added.name: Smooth story opening
patches_added.description: Opens a story from the stories row with a slower, gentler zoom instead of Instagram's quick spring. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Skip the contacts and location popups
patches_added.description: Stops the screens asking you to sync your contacts and turn on location services from opening each time Instagram starts. Nothing else is skipped. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_added.name: Stop videos looping
patches_added.description: Feed videos and reels stop at their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: View live anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. An optional eye button at the top of a live puts you on that one's list. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels

Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls

patches_modified.name: Custom font

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup

patches_modified.name: Download location

patches_modified.name: Feed media max height

patches_modified.name: Force system font

patches_modified.name: Full width feed media

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components

patches_modified.name: Show flairs in home feed

patches_added.name: Unlock Pro
patches_added.description: Unlocks Prismatica Pro by pinning PurchaseService._pro at its single startup writer in the Dart AOT snapshot (libapp.so). The pro flag is a plain bool with no receipt or signature check; `initialize` restores it from one SharedPreferences bool and every paywall reads one bit of it. The patch retargets the null-coalesce branch and rewrites the false literal to the exact value a real purchase writes (NULL+0x20), and does the same in the async catch handler, so no Pro feature can fall back to the paywall. Covered: Batch Export, cross-project grade copy/paste. Grading tools are free and unchanged. Statically and packaging verified on 1.5.8; not yet exercised on a device.

patches_modified.name: Remove Watermark
patches_modified.description: Removes the "PRISMATICA" watermark from the live preview and GPU exports by retargeting the free-tier gate of the procedural GLSL fragment shader embedded in libharwin_native.so: `if (uIsPro == 0)` becomes `if (uIsPro == 2)`, a value the renderer can never pass because the uniform is filled from one native field that only holds 0 or 1. Builds that already gate on `uIsPro == 2` (1.5.8 and later) have the branch unreachable and are reported as already watermark-free instead of failing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Patches the procedural GLSL shader in libharwin_native.so to disable the "PRISMATICA" watermark in the video player and exported videos.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is a local 'is_premium' SharedPreferences flag (in the 'rawcam_prefs' file) read on cold start into a StateFlow. Unlocks RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, custom boosted modes and the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. It also neutralizes PairIP's Play Store licensing (fired from both Application.attachBaseContext and LicenseContentProvider.onCreate, so a repacked copy no longer gets bounced to the Play Store paywall at launch).

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Edge
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.
